checked_properties: Acquired-only pack and proposal shapes; no hidden reference/full-document fields.
Every unavailable aspect or missing citation blocks supported answering, even with narrative cues present.
Unknown candidate aspects cannot exclude potentially conflicting quantities; known mismatches can.
Exact scoped identity retains namespace/source distinctions and nulls; wrong direct values are scored, not repaired.
Refusal prefixes do not exempt material direct claims from support checks.
Duplicate occurrences collapse only at identical exact scope/value while preserving citation provenance.
Compact prompt projection is lossless/canonical and detached; unused registry content is rejected.
Clarification aspects remain explicit; same-scope numeric conflicts are insufficient rather than false relational clarification.
Large decimal strings remain exact; malformed JSON, Unicode, unknown booleans and invalid pointers are controlled errors.

findings.fix: Coalesce each exact scope/value inside joint assignments and across equivalent hypotheses; union occurrence and citation provenance; keep diagnostic claims.
Require exact canonical reprojection of the expanded pack; reject unused, extra, reordered or noncanonical registry content.
Validate canonical serialization is UTF-8 and turn Unicode/serialization recursion failures into controlled BindingError.
